name: show_earth_companion
description: Open the Kamoʻoalewa companion illustration in the Orrery. This is the dedicated Earth-companion replay, not Rubin's separate 2025 PN7 find. The default close framing follows Kamoʻoalewa; the solar-system framing shows its whole orbit. Playback continues forward until the visitor pauses it.

view.description: follow (default) tracks Kamoʻoalewa closely; solar-system shows its whole path around the Sun.
